## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the motivation/context. Mention any dependencies that are required for this change.

## Linked Issues

Closes # (issue number)

## Type of Change

Please delete options that are not relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (e.g. SpecKit `rounded-none` borders).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or linting errors.
- [ ] I have run local test suites (`npm run test`) and all checks passed.
- [ ] If applicable, I have tested responsive states (desktop & mobile).
